topics: A-core: A computer-use agent method or system that perceives and acts on a graphical or browser interface (desktop, mobile, web): an architecture, policy or VLA model, planner or grounder; training data, SFT or RL for such an agent; a world model, simulator or digital twin used by or for it; or its memory and reflection. Pure API/function-calling agents with no GUI or browser surface are NOT this topic.

B-component: A direct contribution to computer-use agents that is not itself an agent method: a benchmark or interactive environment; a GUI grounding or screen-parsing dataset or model; a judge, reward model or verifier for GUI trajectories; or an evaluation-methodology, safety / prompt-injection or empirical study of such agents. UI code generation that never acts on the interface and general VLM benchmarks without interaction are NOT this topic.
